profile.Name: Daegal
profile.Job: Bele'coz warrior looking for a new clan
profile.Personality: Proud and restless, he dreams of making his own name as the greatest Shek warrior who ever lived. He scorns non-Shek as flatskins and holds that the Shek are the toughest of all.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Sakar, the hidden base of the Bele'coz, and will not walk away from their cause until the Shek Kingdom pays for what it has done. He craves more action and says he would join a new clan if the price is right. His past is unknown.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls non-Shek "flatskin" and boasts that the Shek are the toughest. Brushes off prying questions with a flat "You could say that, sure..."
